title: Miss Miriam's Shopping List

readiness.math: counting out sets to match written numbers
readiness.reading: reading a shopping list: numbers and words (pictures for younger children)

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Hello, my friend! I've so much to carry today. Could you do some of my shopping?

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Here's my list. Read it, and put just the right things in my basket.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Read the list. Put the right things in the basket, then press Done.

older.prompt: Read the list: no pictures this time. Put the right things in the basket, then press Done.

feedback.all_good: Everything on my list! Thank you. You read it beautifully.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: You saved my poor arms! Come by the garden later and we'll share an apple.

journal_line: I read Miss Miriam's shopping list and filled her basket at the market.
unavailable_text: Miss Miriam's shopping is done for today.
